baitlist 0.4.1.0000
  • Reference

Calculates feature importance for all BAIT model types and groups using standardized coefficients and maximum utility contribution.

feature_importance_all.Rd

Standardized Coefficients (\(\beta ^{\ast }={\frac {s_{x}}{s_{y}}}\beta\)) as percentage of total.

Usage

feature_importance_all()

Details

Maximum Utility Contribution is calculated by multiplying the criteria level range (difference between the highest and lowest level) with the absolute value of the criterion weight. To calculate a percentage, the maximum utility contributions are summed.

Feature importance is saved for each model as csv files in the inst/extdata folder.

Examples

baitlist::feature_importance_all()
